hookups.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 (South Shore Campground loop search: 45 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' sites 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp', 'Full Hookup - no'; 6 'WALK TO' sites no electric) + https://www.larimercamping.com/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=489&contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Electricity Hookup: 50'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 45 drive-in 50-amp electric sites (S01-S21, S26-S28, S31-S51; posted vehicle lengths 25-60 ft, mostly pull-through, gravel) and 6 walk-to tent sites (S22-S25, S29, S30). One wheeled camping unit per site.

sites.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 (South Shore loop site list: types, 'Max Vehicle Length' 25-60 with Pull-Through/Back-In; 'One Camping Unit Per Site') + https://www.larimercamping.com/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=489&contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Site Access: Drive-In', 'Driveway Entry: Pull-Through', 'Max Vehicle Length: 30', 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: No dump station at the campground: the nearest is about 2 miles away and costs $15 a use.

facilities.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=489&contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Distance to Dump Station (Miles): 2') + https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 banner ('Starting in summer 2024, RV dump stations will cost $15 per session'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Status: Open year round.') + https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/carter-lake ('Carter Lake requires entrance and camping permits, and is open year round.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: A reservation and a park entrance permit are required before setting up at any site; a no-show unannounced within 24 hours may lose the site (call 970-619-4570). Check-in noon, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Campers MUST make a reservation and purchase a park entrance permit BEFORE setting up at any campsite.'; 'No Shows: ...') + https://www.larimercamping.com/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=489&contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 (Checkin 12:00 pm, Checkout 11:00 am), read 2026-10-26

values.note: South Shore electric sites: $35 a night midweek and $45 Saturday in summer, $25 in winter (June 2027 and January 2027 quotes). Plus tax, the $8.75 reservation fee and a daily entrance permit ($10 per vehicle, $20 with a trailered boat).

fees.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=489&contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 (Camping Fees $35.00 Per Night 06/15/2027, $45.00 06/19/2027, $25.00 01/12/2027; $8.75 fee) + https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('$10/day per vehicle or trailered watercraft. $20/day for vehicle + trailered watercraft.'), read 2026-10-26

note: Larimer County Natural Resources campground on the south end of Carter Lake reservoir, west of Loveland; a few electric sites (S03, S05, S08, S17, S20, S21) are marked near the water. --Claude
summary: Larimer County booking site: confirmed $35/$45 + $8.75 fee. South Shore is all 50-amp electric for RVs (45 drive-in sites, vehicle lengths 25-60 ft, mostly pull-through) plus 6 walk-to tent sites; no dump at the campground (2 miles, $15). Note corrected: there is no non-electric RV loop and the walk-in tent sites are S22-S25/S29/S30, not shoreline S17-S23. Open year round, reservation + entrance permit required. Site S01 pin 90 m off. Phone 970-619-4570 matches (county no-show line).
